entities.name: James
entities.description: One of the two speakers: a programmer and lifelong gamer who worked with Python and C++, makes game mods and his own games, keeps three dogs (Max, Daisy and Ned), supports Liverpool, travels, and through 2022 took up drums, extreme sports, cooking, game streaming and a relationship with Samantha. He and John talk every few days from March to November 2022.

entities.name: John
entities.description: The other speaker: a gamer who took a programming course in March 2022, freelanced, left a three-year IT job in mid-2022 and turned towards organising eSports tournaments and charity gaming events. He also plays chess, reads science fiction and fantasy, metal-detects, blogs about coding and teaches his siblings and parents to code. Called "John" throughout.

entities.name: Samantha
entities.description: The woman James met at a dog-keepers' beach outing on 9 August 2022; she gave him her number, became his girlfriend on 3 September 2022, loves the theatre and a good lager, and by late October 2022 had agreed to move in with him into an apartment near McGee's bar.

entities.name: Jill
entities.description: Someone close to John — James calls her "your Jill" — for whom James brought back a souvenir from his July 2022 trip. The conversation never says how she is related to John.

entities.name: James's sister
entities.description: James's sister, never named. She visited him with his dogs on 21 July 2022 and was with him by the ocean watching a sunset the same day; James says he is blessed with a close bond with her and that they are like a family.

entities.name: James's mother
entities.description: James's mother, never named. She visited him on 19 October 2022 with an army friend of hers; the two women used to tell James stories about their time in the military and their dog, and James played on their old Nintendo console as a child.

entities.name: John's siblings
entities.description: A group entity for John's brothers and sisters, never named individually. They live far apart from him, threw him an all-night gaming marathon when he was younger, enrolled on a programming course in 2022, learned to code from him and were writing their own small games and stories by September 2022. Referred to as "my siblings" and "my younger siblings".

entities.name: John's parents
entities.description: A group entity for John's mother and father, never named. They began learning to code from John shortly before 4 September 2022, which John said brought the family closer; he photographed his father writing his first program.

entities.name: Josh
entities.description: A friend of James's, visited with Mark during the road trip James took with his family in November 2022.

entities.name: Mark
entities.description: A friend of James's, visited with Josh during the road trip James took with his family in November 2022; James and his family stopped at an animal sanctuary on the way to them.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: One of James's dogs, a shepherd, and one of the two he already had in March 2022. He is lovable and playful, cheers James up when he is down, loves swimming at the beach or lake, never misses a frisbee in mid-air, and walks with James on the trail a mile from his house.

entities.name: Daisy
entities.description: One of James's dogs, a Labrador, and one of the two he already had in March 2022. She loves her toys and above all loves to eat, knows sit, stay, paw and rollover, and likes to lie down next to James while he games.

entities.name: Ned
entities.description: The puppy James adopted from a shelter in Stamford in the week before 12 April 2022, a shepherd and his third dog. He was introduced to Max and Daisy on 17 June 2022 and had a routine check-up and a vaccination on 5 August 2022.

entities.name: Luna
entities.description: John's cousin's dog, whose photo John showed James on 7 November 2022; James said Luna is a great name.

entities.name: Stamford
entities.description: The town whose animal shelter James adopted the puppy Ned from in early April 2022.

entities.name: Italy
entities.description: A country James visited in 2021 and called very beautiful with delicious food; the first of the countries he lists having been to.

entities.name: Turkey
entities.description: One of the three countries James had visited as of April 2022, alongside Italy and Mexico.

entities.name: Mexico
entities.description: One of the three countries James had visited as of April 2022, alongside Italy and Turkey.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: The last country John had visited before April 2022. He was impressed by its technologically advanced megacities, the huge screens on its buildings and its street food.

entities.name: Canada
entities.description: The fourth country James visited, on a trip from 11 to 20 July 2022 taking in Toronto and Vancouver.

entities.name: Toronto
entities.description: The Canadian city James bought air tickets for in July 2022 and the main destination of his 11–20 July 2022 trip.

entities.name: Vancouver
entities.description: The second Canadian city James planned to visit on his July 2022 trip.

entities.name: Greenland
entities.description: The country James reached during his July 2022 trip, by way of Nuuk — the fifth country on his list.

entities.name: Nuuk
entities.description: The city in Greenland James got out to during his July 2022 Canada trip, staying only a short while but adding another country to his list.

entities.name: McGee's pub
entities.description: The pub James proposed to John on 26 August 2022 in place of Starbucks, said to serve a great stout as well as light beers. James and Samantha drink there, and in late October 2022 they rented an apartment nearby partly because of it. Called both "McGee's pub" and "McGee's bar".

entities.name: The trail and park near James's house
entities.description: A tranquil walking spot a mile from James's house where he and Max take long walks; he brings a book there and reads as an escape. Described in one exchange as "this nearby trail" and then as "that park", which are joined here as one place.

entities.name: John's programming course
entities.description: The programming class John signed up for on 17 March 2022 to refresh the HTML and CSS he had learned years earlier. He met three new friends on it on 19 April 2022, and his younger siblings had enrolled on a programming course by August 2022.

entities.name: James's game-development course
entities.description: The course combining gaming and programming that James started shortly before 13 June 2022. The class was building a new part of a football simulator and James collected the player databases for it. He said he took it mainly to improve himself, the football connection being a bonus.

entities.name: John's chess club
entities.description: The chess club John joined around July 2022 to practise with other players alongside his online games.

entities.name: John's online programming group
entities.description: The online group of skilled coders passionate about using technology for good that John joined on 19 August 2022. He exchanged contacts with several members and worked with one of them on a project, though he called it a one-off rather than a return to programming work.

entities.name: James's gaming group
entities.description: The group of gaming friends James plays with regularly. They stream their sessions, had a get-together in 2022, and a group of them helped him fix the bug that broke his game project in late April 2022.

entities.name: James's cooking class
entities.description: The cooking class James signed up for on 2 September 2022 at $10 a lesson. At the first lesson the class made simple dishes; James got an omelette right first time and also made meringue and was taught to make dough.

entities.name: John's IT employer
entities.description: The unnamed IT company John worked at for three years and left shortly before 6 August 2022, wanting work that made a difference and matched his values.

entities.name: The charitable foundation John built software for
entities.description: An unnamed foundation working with children, which kept paper records and logged inventory by hand until John volunteered his programming skills and built it a smartphone application.

entities.name: The charity James volunteers with
entities.description: An unnamed organisation that provides necessary items to people who are less fortunate. James volunteered with it in May 2022 and on 19 June 2022 agreed to take John there and introduce him to the staff.

entities.name: The game-development non-profit
entities.description: A non-profit for game developers that emailed John before 3 October 2022 offering him a volunteer position as a programming mentor, teaching coding and assisting with projects — work he saw as the start of a career combining gaming and helping people.

entities.name: Liverpool
entities.description: The football club James supports. He says there is no better club, does not miss a single match, and hoped in June 2022 that they would be champions the following season.

entities.name: Manchester City
entities.description: The football club John supports. In June 2022 he bet James that City would finish above Liverpool; James said City were in bad form with a terrible transfer policy, and John backed the manager to handle it. Called "City" as well.

entities.name: The Witcher 3
entities.description: The game James was deeply into in March 2022 for its story and atmosphere; it inspired the virtual world he built with a gaming friend in April 2022 and, he said in October 2022, the game he made and released. John had not played it in March 2022 and was hooked on it by August 2022. Also called "Witcher 3".

entities.name: Apex Legends
entities.description: James's favourite game to play with his team as of April 2022, which he praised for its graphics and fast-paced gameplay. It was also one of the games played at John's children's hospital charity tournament on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: CS:GO
entities.description: John's favourite game. He played it in a tournament at a gaming convention in March 2022, organised a charity CS:GO tournament on 7 May 2022, and named it the first game he wanted to run state-wide competitions for.

entities.name: Civilization
entities.description: The turn-based strategy series James played for a month up to late April 2022 — John identified it as Civilization VI — managing resources, leading armies and conquering territories. James cited it as a game he had always loved and as the model for the strategy game he wanted to build.

entities.name: Cyberpunk 2077
entities.description: The game John recommended to James on 3 October 2022 as an immersive world with an amazing story. James tried it on 20 October 2022 and found it addictive; John warned that its hardest part is making the right choices, even in dialogue.

entities.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
entities.description: The game John was playing at the end of April 2022 and called cool; James agreed it is awesome. Referred to as "AC Valhalla" and "Valhalla".

entities.name: FIFA 23
entities.description: The football game John was hooked on in November 2022, playable online against players worldwide. James wanted to use it to try the sports genre; John told him to practise first and that all it takes is a gamepad and a sense of timing.

entities.name: Fortnite
entities.description: A game John named in August 2022 as one he could host competitions for, and one of the games played at the charity tournament he held for a children's hospital on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: Super Mario
entities.description: One of the two games James played for hours on his first gaming system, an old Nintendo console belonging to his mother and her army friend; he says those games sparked his passion for gaming. Referred to as "Mario" as well.

entities.name: The Legend of Zelda
entities.description: The other game James played for hours on the old Nintendo console as a child. He also named it in September 2022 as the kind of 2D puzzle adventure he likes, when John described the mobile game he had made.

entities.name: Dungeons of the Dragon
entities.description: The board game John tried in the week before 18 September 2022 when he got into board games; he called it very exciting.

entities.name: The Name of the Wind
entities.description: The fantasy novel John recommended to James on 29 April 2022, calling it part of a trilogy James would love. James had not heard of it and said he would check it out.

entities.name: Kingkiller Chronicle
entities.description: One of the two fantasy series John named as his favourites on 16 June 2022, along with The Stormlight Archive.

entities.name: The Stormlight Archive
entities.description: One of the two fantasy series John named as his favourites on 16 June 2022; he loves how such books build a magical world to escape into and how real the characters feel.

entities.name: The Expanse
entities.description: The science fiction series John recommended to James on 16 June 2022, calling it epic.

entities.name: The game-development magazine
entities.description: An unnamed magazine of tutorials, developer interviews and tips that James recommended to John on 20 September 2022 and that John already read; both said it had helped their game-development skills.

entities.name: John's gaming setup
entities.description: John's gaming rig and desk: a gaming PC with a powerful graphics card, a gaming chair, keyboard and a headset. He reorganised the workspace by August 2022, refurbished the desk with new devices, and in early September 2022 added Sennheiser headphones and a Logitech mouse.

entities.name: James's gaming setup
entities.description: James's gaming gear: a cutting-edge system bought in March 2022, a gaming PC, keyboard, mouse and a comfortable chair, and a new video card bought in the week before 3 October 2022.

entities.name: James's notebook
entities.description: The notebook James writes in. In March 2022 he said he writes all his goals in it and finds it satisfying to check each one off; in September 2022 he said he had started writing down everything he needed to do in a notebook so as not to forget anything.

entities.name: The old Nintendo console
entities.description: The Nintendo console belonging to James's mother and her army friend, which James played as a child — his first gaming system, on which he played Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda for hours. He has a photograph of himself at it with its distinctive gamepad.

entities.name: Video gaming
entities.description: The shared passion the whole conversation runs on. James says games give him joy, are like therapy and were a refuge in tough times; John says they help him relax, escape stress and stay motivated. Both branch out into new genres across 2022.

entities.name: Programming
entities.description: What both men do. James tried it at college and says it became his whole life, working in Python and C++; John did HTML and CSS years earlier, took a course from March 2022, freelanced, volunteered his skills, blogged about it and taught his siblings and parents.

entities.name: Bowling
entities.description: A sport James loves — he got two strikes on 16 March 2022 — and that John dislikes, saying his fingers are too big for it.

entities.name: Metal detecting
entities.description: The hobby John took up around March 2022, walking the beaches with a metal detector. He has mostly found bottle caps, but also some coins and once a gold ring.

entities.name: Playing the drums
entities.description: An instrument both men have played. James started learning a few days before 27 March 2022 and practised daily; John said that same day he had been playing for a month and showed his set, but in September 2022 said he used to play when he was younger and had not for a while.

entities.name: Chess
entities.description: The game John took up shortly before 22 July 2022 to improve his strategy and decision-making, playing mostly online and at a chess club. On 1 November 2022 he won the regional chess tournament.

entities.name: Reading
entities.description: How John relaxes — he is a big reader of science fiction and epic fantasy and nearly filled his bookcase in June 2022. James also loves to read, especially under the covers on a cold winter day, and takes a book to the trail near his house.

entities.name: Skateboarding
entities.description: What James and John were into as ten-year-olds, going to the skate park with a group of friends and helping each other learn tricks; James said they sometimes left class early for it. James still rides occasionally and has taught his dogs to balance on a board.

entities.name: Cooking
entities.description: The hobby James took up on 2 September 2022 by signing up for a class, having never liked cooking but wanting to learn something new. He hoped to cook for John once he had learned more.

entities.name: Extreme sports
entities.description: What James turned to in mid-2022 as a break from his other hobbies: rope jumping on 8 July 2022 from a height of 150 metres, and surfing on 6 July 2022, which he found unexpectedly relaxing.

entities.name: Streaming games
entities.description: What James took up in September 2022. His gaming group already streamed their sessions; he streamed a game himself on the night of 19 September 2022 and was struck by the kind comments from the community.

entities.name: Travel
entities.description: Something both men love. James had been to Italy, Turkey and Mexico by April 2022 and added Canada and Greenland in July 2022; John had last been to Japan. In April 2022 they agreed to try to travel somewhere together the following year.

entities.name: Football
entities.description: The sport James says is the best there is; he supports Liverpool and does not miss a match, and his game-development course was building a football simulator. John supports Manchester City, and in November 2022 was hooked on FIFA 23.

entities.name: The dog-walking and pet-care app
entities.description: The app James proposed on 17 March 2022 when John suggested they build mobile applications together: it would connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and give pet-care information, and its personal touch — each dog's own preferences and needs — was what James said would set it apart.

entities.name: James's childhood dream game
entities.description: The computer game James had wanted to make since he was a child, drawn first as comics with sketches of its main character. Joined here with the long-running project he described in May 2022 as "the project I've been working on for weeks", whose game mechanics a bug broke on 29 April 2022, and the "big project I had been working on for months" he finished in April 2022 after learning a new language — the dates and the details are consistent and no other long-running game project is described in that period.

entities.name: The Witcher-inspired virtual world
entities.description: The virtual world James built with one of his gaming friends on 14 April 2022, inspired by The Witcher 3. He had no screenshot of the whole world but showed John the game character he created for it, whose appearance he based on a woman he passed while walking his dogs.

entities.name: James's Unity strategy game
entities.description: The strategy game James built in Unity, announced finished on 1 September 2022. He made it because he has always loved Civilization and Total War; the hard part was balancing the mechanics and keeping it fair, and he credited perseverance, patience and other people's feedback. In October 2022 he said he had made and released his first game, which may or may not be this one.

entities.name: The small-business website
entities.description: The website John built for a local small business as freelance work — his first professional project outside his class. Progress was slow with hiccups, and the hardest part was working out how to take payments on it.

entities.name: The charity's inventory application
entities.description: The software tool John built for a charitable foundation before 11 May 2022. It replaced paper records and manual inventory with a single smartphone application that tracks inventory, resources and donations and generates reports for analysis.

entities.name: John's first mobile game
entities.description: A 2D adventure game with puzzles and exploration, John's first mobile game and what he called a major career milestone. He worked on it for months in secret and it was due to launch in October 2022; he used a book of game-design tips to build its puzzles and James offered to test it.

entities.name: John's coding blog
entities.description: The blog about coding John started in the week before 16 June 2022. He found it exciting and a little frightening, and enjoyed sharing his coding journey, tracking his progress and connecting with other coders.

entities.name: The portable-smoker startup
entities.description: The startup John began on 19 September 2022 making portable smokers; he had already welded one out of metal and showed James a photo of it.

entities.name: The text-based adventure game John built with his siblings
entities.description: A simple text-based adventure game John and his younger siblings were making together in August 2022 to teach them coding while they had fun; by September 2022 they were writing their own small games and stories.

entities.name: The online board game
entities.description: The online board game John created with a game developer over the weekend of 5–6 November 2022, which he called an incredible experience; they were about to release a demo for feedback and James asked to be kept posted.

claims.text: On 17 March 2022 James offered to invite John to help with parts of his game because of John's knowledge of HTML, and John said it would be great to work with him.

claims.speaker: John

claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The last time James played the slot machines he was so engrossed in the game that he did not notice his wallet being taken out of his pocket; John promised to look after his pockets next time, and James suggested they try something else instead.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John suggested VR gaming, which he had tried a few times and found insanely immersive, and James said he had tried it too and found it startlingly real.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James and John agreed on 17 March 2022 to try VR gaming together on Saturday 19 March 2022.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: Between 17 and 20 March 2022 James made a game avatar and joined a new online gaming platform, and said exploring it and chatting with other gamers made him feel part of a very cool online community.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said the gamers he met on the new platform had shared tips, strategies and gaming stories with him, and that gaming brings people together regardless of their backgrounds.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said gaming is a shared language and passion that had been a refuge for him in tough times, and is what he turns to when he feels overwhelmed — like therapy, where he can relax and get lost in another world.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John said on 20 March 2022 that gaming always helps him escape stress and calms him down during tough times, and is a good way to take a break.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As of 20 March 2022 James had been checking out different styles of gaming, finding it fun to try something fresh and test himself in new ways.
claims.speaker: James

claims.speaker: John

claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James showed John a photograph of his two dogs enjoying themselves in the park on 20 March 2022 and said they had brought a great deal of joy to his life and were the best pals.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James has trained Max and Daisy to sit, stay, give a paw and roll over; he says he has done a lot of training with them, they picked the tricks up fast, and they are like family to him.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John said on 20 March 2022 that he badly wanted a pet but was not in a position to get one yet, and James offered to help him find the perfect one when he was ready.

claims.speaker: James

claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James bought a new cutting-edge gaming system shortly before 27 March 2022 and said its graphics were incredible; he used it to play all kinds of new games, to relax after work and to connect with gaming friends.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: Between 20 and 27 March 2022 John went to a gaming convention where he tried many games, met developers and took part in a tournament playing his favourite game, CS:GO, against skilled players.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said watching the skilled players compete at the March 2022 convention tournament inspired him to improve his own gaming skills.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said on 27 March 2022 that he is always looking to raise his game and hit new goals, and that the same commitment runs through his hobbies and everything else.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James stays motivated and focused by setting small goals and tracking his progress.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: As of 27 March 2022 James was branching out into different types of game, such as RPGs and strategy games, and promised to keep John updated on how he got on with the new genres.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James took part in an online gaming tournament on 3 April 2022, reached the semi-finals and won some rounds, but lost in the final rounds after a close contest.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: At the tournament on 3 April 2022 James met a whole professional team, was given a couple of gaming tips by one of them and got the whole team's autographs, though he did not manage a photograph with them.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The tip James remembered best from the professional player was that you must always communicate properly with your team and never put your ego above the team's success.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James uses voice chat to communicate with his team because it is fast and helps them work together effectively.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: As of 4 April 2022 James's favourite game to play with his team was Apex Legends, which he praised for its awesome graphics and super fast-paced gameplay.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 4 April 2022 James said he was thinking of trying RPGs and MOBAs next and would tell John what he thought of them.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: In the week before 12 April 2022 James adopted a puppy from a shelter in Stamford and named him Ned, giving him three dogs — Max, Daisy and Ned — and he said his days had been much happier with Ned in the family.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John said on 12 April 2022 that he had made little progress on his gaming goals because work and life had been busy, but that it was always nice to remember how happy gaming makes him and how it helps him forget life's stresses.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As of 12 April 2022 John was playing a new RPG set in a futuristic dystopia with a story and world he liked and tough gameplay, though the game was laggy and threw errors, one of which he had hit on 11 April 2022.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James said he would rather wait until the new RPG's bugs were fixed before trying it, but John argued the graphics and immersion were worth it now and talked him round, promising to send him a link.

claims.text: The old Nintendo was James's first gaming system; he played Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda on it for hours as a child, and says those games introduced him to gaming and sparked the passion he has had ever since.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James tried Cyberpunk 2077 on 20 October 2022 and called it a great, addictive game.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John told James on 21 October 2022 that the hardest thing in Cyberpunk 2077 is making the right choices — even the lines chosen in dialogue can make everything go wrong and the choices can be life-changing — and that he does not have to be friends with every character, while avoiding spoilers.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John held a gaming tournament with his friends on the night of 30 October 2022 at which they played Fortnite, Overwatch and Apex Legends and raised a decent sum for a children's hospital.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said the atmosphere at the charity tournament of 30 October 2022 was awesome and competitive and the moment unforgettable, and he showed James a photograph from it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James and Samantha decided to move in together and rented an apartment not far from McGee's bar; James said it was a mutual and informed decision and that the bar being nearby was one of their criteria for choosing the apartment.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James set off on a road trip with his family and his dogs on 4 November 2022, and said exploring new places and taking in nature with them was awesome.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John won the regional chess tournament on 1 November 2022, which he called intense; he said his hard work and practice had paid off and it gave him a huge confidence boost.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's strategy in the regional chess tournament was to analyse and anticipate his opponents' moves so as to stay one step ahead.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John credited studying opening moves and strategies, learning from experienced players, analysing past games and the chess advice James had given him earlier for his tournament win, and sent James a resource on chess openings.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As of 5 November 2022 John was hooked on FIFA 23, a football game that can be played online against people all over the world; James wanted to use it to try the sports genre, and John told him to practise first so that they could play together, saying all it takes is a gamepad and a sense of timing.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James and his family were still on their road trip on 7 November 2022 and had already visited his friends Josh and Mark and had a great time with them.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: Over the weekend of 5–6 November 2022 John worked with a game developer to create an online board game, which he called a fun and unique experience and an incredible one, and was glad to see his ideas come to life.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John and the game developer were about to release a demo of their online board game so others could try it and give feedback, and James asked to be kept posted so that he could support John and give his thoughts.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On the way to Josh and Mark, James and his family visited an animal sanctuary full of rescue dogs, which made James think of his and John's love of dogs.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said he wanted to take all the rescue dogs at the animal sanctuary home but remembered he already has three dogs, and that he thinks having more than three is too much.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 7 November 2022 John said he still had not got a dog although he really wants one, and asked James what having a dog is like.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James said his dogs bring so much joy and friendship that life would not be the same without them, that they make even dark days better and that he does not know what he would do without them.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John showed James a photograph of his cousin's dog, Luna, on 7 November 2022, and said dogs accept us without judgement and bring a daily dose of positivity to his life; James said Luna is a great name.
claims.speaker: John
